title: BOX OF 1980'S BIRD FIGURINES, ...
reason: Genuine hand-painted Shelley Art Deco butterfly vase with shield mark and Rd number (1921 design), plus other china.
findings: All 3 photos checked, with enlarged crops of the base. The vase is genuine Shelley by its marks: green printed shield cartouche 'MADE IN SHELLEY ENGLAND', black printed 'Rd 680712', and hand-written black numbers read as 8433 and 108 (orientation uncertain). Rd 680712 falls in 1921 on Carlton Ware World's registered design table (680147 to 687143 = 1921; https://carltonwareworld.com/registered-design-numbers.htm, read 19 Oct 2026), so the design dates from 1921 and this piece is probably 1920s. Decoration is hand-painted: black shoulder band with purple and green butterflies and a white dotted border above a bright yellow body on a short foot, mid-sized (exact height not stated). This is the Shelley Art Deco butterfly vase type; the pattern number 8433 itself was not confirmed online, but Carters (Australian auctioneer) lists 'Two Art Deco Shelley butterfly vases' (carters.com.au item 1388417, title seen in search results 19 Oct 2026, page not opened so no price seen), so the type is traded. Other items in the box: two tall pink swan or flamingo figurines with gilt beaks (1980s style), a small pale blue Wedgwood style jasper dish, a fluted bowl with posy decoration and gilt foot, and two cream jugs with pink rose sprays; none show a legible mark (bases not photographed).
condition: Vase shows no chips, cracks or crazing in the photos, only a tiny speck in the yellow glaze and light staining and wear on the base rim. Jugs, bowl and figurines look intact from the front; bases not shown.
rescore_note: Vase is a genuine hand-painted 1920s Shelley Art Deco butterfly piece (shield mark, Rd 680712 is a 1921 registration per the Carlton Ware World table read 19 Oct 2026) in good condition and carries the lot; the rest is 1980s figurines and plain china. About the $80-200 band. No comparable sale seen.
